mandate: C396 — test the cross-sectional intraday MAGNET: REALIZED MAGNITUDE-DISTRIBUTION SHANNON ENTROPY x SEASONAL-DISLOCATION mean-reversion stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (1296 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: perp_close real 5m kline close; log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|. MAGNET scalars over fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing log returns X=r[t-W+1..t] ending at bar t: A=|X| partitioned into B=10 equal-frequency bins by the window's own decile thresholds q_b=quantile(A,b/10) (q_0=min, q_10=max); bin b: q_{b-1} <= a < q_b (last bin inclusive); n_b=count, p_b=n_b/W; magnet_ent[t]=-sum_b p_b ln(p_b) (nats); magnet_conc[t]=max_b p_b. NaN if t<W or any NaN/non-finite in window. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 2 real (magnet_ent_dev, magnet_conc_dev) + 2 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates, never edges). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs and valid denominators; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs requirements (t<W=256 or NaN in trailing W-bar return window).

methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; abs_ret=|log_return|.
methodology.primitives: fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing log returns X=r[t-W+1..t] ending at bar t: A=|X| partitioned into B=10 equal-frequency bins by the window's own decile thresholds q_b=quantile(A,b/10); p_b=n_b/W; magnet_ent=-sum_b p_b ln(p_b); magnet_conc=max_b p_b.
methodology.signals: magnet_ent/magnet_conc over fixed W=256; score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 1296 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 4 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment.
methodology.magnet_vectorization_note: magnet_ent/magnet_conc via sliding_window_view(log_return, 256) per-asset; per-window np.quantile deciles (axis=1) + count(q <= a)-1 bin assignment clipped to [0,B-1] and bincount for counts; entropy -sum p ln p (0 ln 0=0), concentration max p. Window-NaN enforced by finite-count over the W-bar trailing returns. No Python loop over bars x assets — validated against brute force with maxdiff < 1e-12 in tests.
